captions: Treadmill, 8 p.m. Episode 9 on your phone.
9 episodes this week. You know every character's name.
Walking home in the snow. His house is next to yours.
Every winter, his footprints went to the mosque first.
Tonight, the snow at his door is untouched. 9 days.
Your kitchen. Soup on the stove. Dates in a bag.
You knock. A long wait. Then a weak voice: “Who is it?”
He's been ill all week. Tonight, he's not alone.

post.caption:
9 days, no one has seen Uncle Karim. Allah has. 🤍

Sometimes the good deed waiting for you is one door away.

“So whoever does an atom's weight of good will see it.” (99:7)

Tonight, before Isha: knock on one door.
